نقترض (form VIII)
# نَقْتَرِضُ (naqtariḍu) /naq.ta.ri.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# نُقْتَرَضُ (nuqtaraḍu) /nuq.ta.ra.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# نَقْتَرِضَ (naqtariḍa) /naq.ta.ri.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# نُقْتَرَضَ (nuqtaraḍa) /nuq.ta.ra.dˤ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
